'''OM-7''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], OM-7 along with [[OM-5/Legends|OM-5]] were sent by their [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Ryloth)/Legends|Commander]] to check out a Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Gunship]] that was blocking their path. OM-5 warned OM-7 of clone troopers, but instead found the gunship full of explosives. A clone trooper found the pair in close range of the gunship and activated the charges. The explosion destroyed OM-7 and OM-5, and also made the hills collapse, making a huge barrier for the droid army's path.
